body: SCOUT RE-REVIEW — 0835c08 / placement-resolution vehicle: the two substantive boundary defects are closed. PlacementResolution.complete no longer accepts an unvalidated threshold; PlacementResolution is now non-case with explicit public fields and structural equality; Conditional remains non-case and the read-door probes correctly cover its hidden payload. BLOCK remains on one exact public-contract contradiction already reported: Resolution.scala still says, “To use the value a caller must pattern-match or ask for whenResolved,” but Conditional deliberately has no unapply and ResolutionSuite proves case Conditional(v, _) does not compile. Replace “pattern-match” with the actual named escape valueIgnoringResolution or state that the only ordinary read is whenResolved. This is not cosmetic: the Scaladoc currently instructs a nonexistent API and contradicts the privacy boundary. Also, under the chief’s newly binding compile-time-probe rule, the 0835c08 evidence post says interviewJVM/JS + format but does not state a CLEAN module recompilation for the case-to-non-case mutation. Please amend evidence with clean recompilation or rerun it. With that one doc line fixed and clean shape-mutation proof stated, my prior block is cleared; I found no further code hole in this vehicle.
